prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a bustling farm scene during the autumn harvest. In the center stands a tall wooden barn with weathered planks. To the left of the barn, a farmer in a blue hat holds a golden sheaf of wheat. Next to him, a brown dog sits patiently on the dry grass. The farmer looks at the dog while holding the crop. A red tractor is parked near the barn entrance, its large black wheels resting firmly on the ground. A woman in a yellow dress stands next to the tractor, pointing toward the open field. She interacts with a child in green overalls who is looking at her gesture. The child holds a small basket filled with red apples. On the right side of the image, a scarecrow with a straw hat stands guard among the rows of corn. A black crow perches on the scarecrow's shoulder, looking out at the horizon. Behind the scarecrow, a white goat grazes on the leftover stalks. A man in an orange vest carries a heavy sack of grain toward a wooden cart. The cart is positioned near the edge of the frame, loaded with pumpkins. A gray cat sleeps on top of the largest pumpkin in the cart. A young girl in a pink ribbon braids hair while sitting on a hay bale near the cart. She is next to the sleeping cat but does not touch it. An older man with a gray beard leans against the barn wall, watching the activities. He holds a pipe in his hand. A rooster with bright feathers struts across the foreground, pecking at scattered seeds. There is no modern machinery like combines or drones visible in this rustic setting. There is no rain or cloudy sky, as the sun shines brightly overhead. The composition remains clean and simple, emphasizing the shapes and colors of the rural life depicted.
